categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Anke Biotechnology primarily operates in the biopharmaceutical industry with key segments including gene-engineered drugs, biological detection reagents, modern traditional Chinese medicine, chemical synthetic drugs, peptide drugs, forensic DNA testing, and medical services. The company also has subsidiaries engaged in healthcare management and medical services. Its product portfolio covers human interferon alpha-2b, human growth hormone, monoclonal antibody drugs, and various diagnostic kits.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced gene engineering technologies, including recombinant DNA technology for drug development. Manufacturing adheres strictly to GMP standards with complete production lines for biopharmaceuticals, chemical drugs, and peptide raw materials. It also employs transdermal absorption technology for traditional Chinese medicine patches and develops cutting-edge products like mRNA vaccines, CAR-T cell therapies, and bispecific antibodies through in-house R&D and strategic collaborations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include hospitals, healthcare institutions, forensic and judicial agencies, and pharmaceutical distributors across China. The company serves patients requiring treatments in viral infections, growth disorders, oncology, and infertility. Its forensic DNA products cater to law enforcement and forensic identification markets. The company also targets the pediatric and oncology therapeutic areas with specialized products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales in East China (excluding Anhui), Anhui province, Central and Southwest China, North and Northeast China, South China, and Northwest China. It has a minor export business. Its subsidiaries and production facilities are located in key Chinese cities including Hefei, Shanghai, Wuxi, Anqing, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Anke Biotechnology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of biopharmaceuticals, chemical drugs, and diagnostic reagents. It controls the entire value chain from product development through production to marketing and distribution, including direct hospital sales and distributor networks.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with strategic focus on gene-engineered drugs, oncology biologics, and precision medicine. It invests heavily in R&D, advancing clinical trials for monoclonal antibodies, bispecific antibodies, ADC drugs, mRNA vaccines, and cell therapies. The firm pursues collaborations and equity investments in frontier biotechnologies and aims to expand its product pipeline in tumor treatment and gene therapy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of biopharmaceuticals, chemical drugs, peptide raw materials, and diagnostic reagents. The company employs a combination of direct sales to hospitals and end customers, as well as distribution through authorized dealers and agents. It also earns income from technical services and licensing. Export sales constitute a small portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anhui Anke Biotechnology is a leading domestic biopharmaceutical company with a strong position in gene-engineered drugs and biological reagents. It competes with other Chinese biotech firms and pharmaceutical manufacturers in oncology, antiviral, and growth hormone markets. The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive product pipeline, advanced R&D capabilities, and integrated supply chain. It holds a top-tier market share in interferon alpha-2b and growth hormone segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.87 billion, a 22.94% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 847 million, up 20.47%. It maintains strong cash flow generation with operating cash flow increasing by 36.34%. The company’s total assets reached nearly RMB 4.95 billion, reflecting a 16.3% growth. R&D expenses rose by 53.41%, underscoring its commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Anke Biotechnology offers differentiated value through its robust gene-engineered drug portfolio, including domestically leading interferon alpha-2b and growth hormone products, and its newly launched monoclonal antibody for oncology. The company emphasizes product quality, innovation, and patient compliance, supported by advanced manufacturing and quality control systems. Its integrated R&D and production capabilities, combined with strategic investments in cutting-edge biotechnologies, position it as a pioneer in precision medicine and biologics in China.
